scientific_scope_status: The visible P3 result reports a moment-to-finite-time-transport theorem for unknown number-conserving exchange dynamics with supplied structural bounds, addressable complete phase randomization and one designated reset port. The cold-port leading costs are O(n^3D)cycles, O(n^(5/2)D)native time, O(n^4D)individual phase operations plus logarithmic accuracy. A state-independent finite-purity port converges to tau_q^tensor n with its stationary purity floor.
